main.name: tokimeki-space public server
main.description: The public face of a server: a publicPolicy space paired with a tech.tokimeki.forum.server space of the same owner and skey. Anyone can obtain a credential (and, at the PDS level, write); what is shown is decided by the service index. Members may also attach tokimeki-poll polls to threads: tech.tokimeki.poll.poll and tech.tokimeki.poll.vote records live in the same space and are served by the poll AppView (poll.tokimeki.tech), which the community relays writes to.
